confirm.deactivateBody: {name} will immediately lose access to Ecotech. All active sessions will be ended and {name} will no longer be able to sign in.
confirm.activateBody: {name} will be able to sign in to Ecotech again with their password.
confirm.resetBody: A new temporary password will be generated for {name}.
confirm.resetSessions: All of {name}'s active sessions will end immediately.
confirm.resetNextSignIn: {name} must choose a new password at the next sign-in.
confirm.resetShownOnce: The temporary password is shown to you once — share it securely.
confirm.logoutBody: Every active session of {name} will be signed out immediately — including the one they are using now.
confirm.logoutAgain: {name} can sign in again with their password.
